relationships.subject: pregabalin
relationships.evidence_quote: it binds to the α2δ subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels (VGCCs), thereby reducing calcium influx and inhibiting the presynaptic release of excitatory neurotransmitters such as glutamate, substance P, and norepinephrine [9]

relationships.subject: pregabalin
relationships.evidence_quote: Gabapentinoids, such as pregabalin, have been shown in animal models to suppress substance P and CGRP release from inflamed spinal tissues

relationships.subject: pregabalin
relationships.evidence_quote: Reintroduction of low-dose pregabalin led to symptom stabilization within two months, suggesting that pregabalin may have contributed to the control of pruritus.

key_findings: In a PN patient on nemolizumab, pregabalin discontinuation caused pruritus relapse and low-dose reintroduction restored control.
Pregabalin may act via VGCC alpha2delta inhibition and suppression of substance P and CGRP release.
